question: Do L9H1 and L9H4 implement the aspectual read by transporting the exact attention contribution of the since/by cue to the final subject position?
population: The 64 valid A1/A2 answer-changing rows from the frozen discovery corpus; P/C selectivity remains bound by the parent and module-factorial screens.

operator.source_term: For source k, replace the paired base term pat_base[q,k,h]*v_base[k,h] by pat_donor[q,k,h]*v_donor[k,h] inside the otherwise native base head preprojection activation, then run the exact c_proj and suffix.
operator.attention: unnormalized signed bilinear attention exactly as executed by the checkpoint
operator.full_head_pair: replace both complete paired donor preprojection head activations at q

source_positions.period: the token two places after cue

predictions.pred_a_exact_instrument: The manual attention path matches native logits, the sum of all source terms reconstructs each native H1/H4 preprojection vector, and every row has exactly one aligned since/by token difference.
predictions.pred_b_full_pair_recurrence: The jointly swapped complete H1/H4 outputs have positive A1 and A2 mean recovery and direction fraction at least 0.80 in each family.
predictions.pred_c_cue_source_sufficiency: The joint cue-term swap retains at least 70% of the full H1/H4 pair's mean target recovery and has direction fraction at least 0.80 in A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_d_cue_source_specificity: Joint cue-term mean target recovery is at least twice the maximum absolute mean target recovery of the registered last, period, and self source-term swaps.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage: All seven registered arms produce all 64 row outcomes with finite logits and no dropped row.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: license the cue-source read for L9H1/H4.
terminal.null: The run is valid but B, C, or D fails: retain the heads as causal writers without a cue-source read claim.
terminal.invalid: Instrument identity, native capability, source alignment, finiteness, or exact coverage fails. No source position, head, threshold, row, or arm may be changed after opening outcomes.

novelty: The prior screens localized whole residuals, modules, and heads. This is the first exact source-term intervention asking what those aspectual heads read, with three preregistered within-row positional alternatives.
